messages:
Amanda (SE): FYI partner (Helix Systems) hit a blocker on their SI deployment during image install — driver/firmware mismatch + license server failing cert handshake. Opening thread to sync arch + field ops.

Maria - SI: Customer env: air-gapped VPC, Palo Alto FW, kernel 5.15, Mellanox NICs. Installer fails at kmod load, logs show 'firmware mismatch: 0x27'. They tried kernel patch; didn't help. Ticket #HC-4421.

Raj Patel: Ok. can you paste the small logs? Also what's the expected hw SKU and image version?

Maria - SI: SKUs: MX4512, image: rwinf-2.4.1-ubuntu20.04.iso. Logs: ```modprobe mlx5_core: firmware 0x22 != 0x27
...
Failed to contact license server https://licensing.partnercorp.com:443 - TLS handshake timeout```

Lucas M.: Two quick asks: 1) open ports for license: 443 outbound to licensing partner + 123 for NTP; 2) confirm CPU microcode/BIOS (some Mellanox firmwares require newer BIOS). Sharing short port list:
```
Outbound: 443, 80
NTP: 123
SSH for field: 22
```

Oncall Bot: Incident HC-4421 created and assigned to raj.p. Priority: P1 - SI Implementation escalated. https://redwood.incidents/HC-4421

Amanda (SE): Can eng-arch jump on a quick 30m screen share with the partner and field eng at 16:00 PT? We need to decide: push patch, swap firmware, or quick fallback to marketplace image.

Raj Patel: I'm available. I'll triage driver vs license in parallel. If licensing certs failing, fallback to cloud marketplace image temporarily to keep customer running.

Maria - SI: Customer cannot accept outbound to licensing for compliance. They requested on-prem license servers or signed manifest. Needs legal ok. Timeline: they want go-live by next Thu — urgent.

Lucas M.: If outbound blocked, we can ship signed license manifest or offline activation. I'll draft a manifest flow and an installer flag: `--offline-licensing /path/to/manifest`.

Amanda (SE): Thanks. Action items: Raj - driver/firmware triage + BIOS check; Lucas - offline manifest flow + quick marketplace fallback doc; Maria - coordinate customer legal & schedule 16:00 PT call. I'll create calendar and post invite.

Maria - SI: Added invite and test dataset attached. :thumbsup: 

Raj Patel: assigned. Will post findings to this thread within 2 hours.

Amanda (SE): tagging eng-arch for visibility — could someone from runtime team attend? Lucas M. you'll lead the dev-side.

Oncall Bot: Reminder: HC-4421 scheduled screening at 16:00 PT.
